map.化工品进场自检：按纯度、水分、酸值三项判定品质: Incoming self-check of chemicals: judge quality by three items — purity, moisture, acid value
map.储运安全：酸值偏高提示氧化变质: Storage/transport safety: high acid value signals oxidation and degradation
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于投料验收: Report usability: all three must pass before the batch is accepted for charging
map.逐项判定：纯度≥99.0%、水分≤0.1%、酸值≤0.2mgKOH/g；三项均满: Item-by-item: purity ≥ 99.0%, moisture ≤ 0.1%, acid value ≤ 0.2 mgKOH/g; all three satisfied = pass. Acid value reflects free acid; a rise signals hydrolysis/oxidation.
Purity 99.2% (≥99.0 ✓), moisture 0.05% (≤0.1 ✓), acid value 0.1 mgKOH/g (≤0.2 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If acid value rises to 0.3 it fails, indicating degradation.
map.酸值=中和 1g 样品中游离酸所需 KOH 毫克数（mgKOH/g）；越高表示游: Acid value = milligrams of KOH needed to neutralize the free acid in 1 g of sample (mgKOH/g); higher means more free acid, easier corrosion and oxidation, so it must be kept within the limit.
map.属工业优级；电子/医药级常要求更高，须按用途定合格线，水分与酸值超标即便纯度够也: It is industrial premium grade; electronic/pharma grades often require higher, and the pass line depends on use — excess moisture or acid value fails the batch even if purity is sufficient.
map.纯度与酸值共同反映产品质量，酸值偏高表明氧化: Purity and acid value jointly reflect product quality; high acid value indicates oxidation
